method: The reference is read the way Docker's distribution reference grammar reads it. Everything after @ is a digest of the form algorithm:encoded; sha256 must carry 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters and sha512 must carry 128. A colon after the last slash starts the tag, while earlier colons belong to a registry port. The first of two or more path components is a registry when it contains a dot or colon, equals localhost, or is a bracketed IPv6 address; otherwise the registry is docker.io. index.docker.io and registry-1.docker.io normalize to docker.io, a single-component Docker Hub name gains the library/ namespace, and a reference with neither tag nor digest reports the effective tag latest. Repository components are checked against the lowercase distribution grammar and registry plus repository may not exceed 255 characters; tags may be up to 128 characters. The parser never contacts a registry, resolves a manifest, or proves that an image or tag exists.
